parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `Playcut.stub` in `_Plant_PlaycutStub.swift` (line 16) and `Breakpoint.stub` in `PlaylistStubs.swift` (line 58) are test-fixture stub factories within the `PlaylistTesting` source group of the `Playlist` package. Per the decision rules, any cluster where even one record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both are. Consolidating these stubs would couple distinct domain-model test helpers (`Playcut` vs `Breakpoint`) to a shared factory, risking fragility in test isolation for no production benefit. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.71) is expected for stub factories that follow the same `.stub` naming convention across different model types.
